name: Hitachi Energy India Ltd
title: Hitachi Energy India Ltd - 543187 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Record backlog Rs 29,555 Cr (+53.6% YoY) and a new Rs 2,000 Cr greenfield transformer plant (30-40 GVA) signal capacity expansion, while FY26 orders were flat at +1.6% and non-HVDC domestic orders weakened.

capex.quote: the Board approved an additional investment of Rs. 2,000 Crores. This includes among other initiatives, the establishment of greenfield large power transformer facility in Karjan

triggers.label: Extra Rs 2,000 Cr capex; total ~Rs 4,000 Cr
triggers.quote: With this, our total cumulative capex stands close to Rs. 4,000 Crores.

triggers.label: Record backlog Rs 29,555 Cr, +53.6%
triggers.quote: strong order backlog of Rs. 29,555.3 Crores, an increase of 53.6% YoY

triggers.label: FY26 orders +1.6% only
triggers.quote: we have a growth of 1.6% in FY26 to Rs. 18,456.5 Crores

guidance.value: production by last quarter of CY2028
guidance.quote: to produce our large power transformers and HVDC converter transformer by last quarter of 2028 calendar year

red_flags.label: Non-HVDC domestic orders falling in FY26
red_flags.quote: the non HVDC order inflow, at least the domestic non-HVDC order inflow was falling in FY26 over FY25

red_flags.label: Royalty to parent rising
red_flags.quote: we need to give royalty to ensure that the technologies are available

evasions.quote: I think when we investigated that, it is not the case with us.
No, we don't take that because for us, every data center is 15% of addressable market.
No, we could not share exact numbers, we have been saying as a ballpark percentage.
